semiconductor_relevance: High — CORNERSTONE operates as a silicon photonics rapid prototyping foundry, providing essential services for the development of photonic integrated circuits.
summary: CORNERSTONE is an open-source silicon photonics rapid prototyping foundry that enables researchers and innovators to design, fabricate, and test photonic integrated circuits. By lowering barriers to innovation, it supports the development of next-generation photonic solutions through its collaborative community and advanced fabrication capabilities.

regional_presence.United Kingdom: CORNERSTONE is hosted by the University of Southampton, University of Glasgow, and the UK’s Science and Technology Facilities Council.
